captions.detailed: This 3D model is a customizable shelf talker designed to clip onto a shelf edge. It features a long, thin, rectangular horizontal bar that acts as the support backing for extruded text. At one end, it has a square-shaped, open-sided mounting clip designed to slide over the front edge of a shelf of a specific thickness.
captions.instruction: Create a customizable shelf talker with a front label bar and an integrated mounting clip. Users should be able to specify the label text, font size, letter spacing, and the thickness of the shelf it will clip onto.
captions.factory: The design uses a union of several parts. The text is rendered using the 'write' module with customizable font size, spacing, and font file. A base support bar is created using a 'cube' primitive. The mounting clip is assembled from three separate 'cube' primitives positioned using 'translate' and 'rotate' to create a U-shaped clamp adjusted to the 'shelf_thickness' parameter.
